description: What a blind salon banner may say about itself on POST /api/mls/push/blind-banner (chat-delivery `[PUSH_BLIND]`, docs/wiki/protocols/channel-encryption.md). `missing` are the four things the phone needs before it opens a salon push at all; `refused` are the reasons an open that DID run did not show the message - the tokens `open_graine_push` answers (frontend/src-tauri/src/mobile/background.rs) plus the three the Android service names itself (`empty-text`, `exception`, `unstated`). `silent` are open answers that are not a banner at all, so they are never reported. Each side asserts its own constants against this file: the controller spec, the Rust background tests, the Kotlin BlindBannerReportTest.
